Name: Simple Faithful Plus Sprites
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b][size=5]Simple Faithful+ Sprites[/size][/b]
Fresh seasonal outfits with the familiar Stardew Valley look.
Simple Faithful+ Sprites updates supported characters’ clothing while keeping their original faces, hair, proportions and native animation layouts. The outfits complement Simple Faithful+ Portraits, and both mods can be used independently.
[heading][b]Seasonal Outfits[/b][/heading]
Clothing changes automatically with spring, summer, fall and winter.
The artwork uses direct edits of the original sprite pixels, keeping characters recognizable and comfortable alongside the vanilla world.
[heading][b]Features[/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]Seasonal clothing updates across 45 supported vanilla characters.[/*]
[*]Preserved native faces, hair, silhouettes and animation positions.[/*]
[*]Seasonal clothing on reviewed kissing animations.[/*]
[*]Automatic switching when the season changes.[/*]
[*]Individual character switches.[/*]
[*]An Original sprites option.[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support.[/*]
[*]Settings translated into all 12 built-in game languages.[/*]
[/list][heading][b]Keep Your Original Sprites[/b][/heading]
Prefer a character’s original appearance? Disable that character in the settings.
Choose [b]Original sprites[/b] to leave all loaded character artwork untouched. If another sprite mod is installed, its loaded appearance is retained.
[heading][b]Compatibility and Coverage[/b][/heading]
Custom replacement sprite sheets are preserved rather than overwritten.
Seasonal edits cover normal standing and walking animations, reviewed kissing frames and selected additional poses. Special costumes and unsupported event animations retain their loaded artwork.
The clothing is designed to complement the portrait collection; individual outfit details may differ between portraits and world sprites.
This mod changes appearance only. Dialogue, relationships, schedules and gameplay remain unchanged.
[heading][b]Requirements[/b][/heading]
[b]Required:[/b] SMAPI 4.2.0 or newer.
[b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu for convenient settings.
[b]Optional companion:[/b] Simple Faithful+ Portraits.
[heading][b]Installation[/b][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract Simple Faithful+ Sprites.[/*]
[*]Place the [b]SimpleFaithful+Sprites[/b] folder inside your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Seasonal artwork is enabled by default.
[heading][b]Settings[/b][/heading]
With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, you can enable or disable the mod, choose Seasonal or Original artwork, and toggle individual characters.
Without Generic Mod Config Menu, the settings are available in the generated [b]config.json[/b] file.
[heading][b]Credits[/b][/heading]
Original Stardew Valley sprite artwork by [b]ConcernedApe[/b].
Seasonal sprite edits and mod development by [b]Xsyy[/b].

[size=6][b]Simple Journal Expansion[/b][/size]
Give your quest journal more room with a taller, two-page book that fits Stardew Valley’s style. Browse more quests at once, with curved paper pages, a stitched leather cover, a sewn centre binding and a ribbon bookmark.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

• Two quest-list columns, like an open book.
• Displays up to 18 quests at standard UI scale on a 1920×1080 screen—nine per page.
• Automatically adjusts to your screen size and UI scale.
• Uses a single-page layout in narrow windows.
• Spreads shorter quest lists across both pages.
• Keeps normal paging available for additional quests.
• Improved spacing keeps titles clear of NEW badges and pin controls.
• Long titles wrap or shorten when necessary. Hover over shortened titles to read their full names.
• Matching book styling for quest details.
• Mouse and controller support.
• Supports all 12 built-in game languages.

Open your Journal normally. There are no extra hotkeys or settings to configure.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]


[b]Simple Journal Pin[/b]
Keeps quest pinning and its journal controls accessible. Pinning requires the separate Simple Journal Pin mod.

[b]Deluxe Journal[/b]
Automatically detects Deluxe Journal and expands its Quests page. Tabs sit outside the book, with aligned heading, close and back controls. Tasks, Notes and overlay settings retain their original layouts and content. Compatibility was checked against Deluxe Journal 1.4.1.

[b]Texture themes[/b]
The pages use Stardew’s native paper textures and fonts, allowing texture recolours to affect them. The leather cover, binding and bookmark retain their own colours.

This mod changes the journal’s appearance and layout. Quest progress, objectives, rewards and cancellation behave normally.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

• Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later.
• SMAPI 4.4.0 or later.
Simple Journal Pin and Deluxe Journal are optional.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

Extract the SimpleJournalExpansion folder into your Mods folder.
When updating, replace the existing SimpleJournalExpansion folder.
To uninstall, remove the mod’s folder. No save migration is required.
